sloka: तिर्यक् च सह नक्षत्रैः सम्गतौ चन्द्रभास्करौ ।भास्कराम्शुभिरादीप्तम् तमसा च समावृतम् ॥६-२२-८॥।।
transliteration: tiryak ca saha nakṣatraiḥ samgatau candrabhāskarau ।bhāskarāmśubhirādīptam tamasā ca samāvṛtam ॥6-22-8॥।।

translations.english: The Sun and moon moved obliquely (from south to North) along with the stars. On account of the darkness that covered even the sun was not shining. The sky lighted by the meteors shone and unparalleled thunder shot forth.
translations.hindi: नक्षत्रों सहित सूर्य चन्द्र की गति तिरछी हो गई । उस समय सूयं के रहते भी आकारा में अन्धकार छाया हुआ था
